title: studio → runner: execute one run
description: Published by studio's outbox relay on subject cmd.run.<host>.<env> (stream CMD) with Nats-Msg-Id <run_id>:<attempt>. The runner checks KV cancels before it starts, runs the graph in data.workflow, writes every output under data.output_prefix and reports on evt.run.<session_id>.*.

workflow.description: the resolved graph: the registry workflow, or the user workflow's snapshot, with the run's inputs applied and every param of every node filled (defaults included), so the runner reads no defaults of its own. Bypassed nodes are spliced out (their consumers rewired to the pass-through source) and `position` is dropped, so the runner never sees `bypass` or `position`. An `in` key may name a value param of the node (int, float, seed, string, text, image): the stage gets the upstream value as that param, and its `params` entry is still filled (ignored). An optional input may be unwired: the stage gets no such key. Image values are resolved (defs image: key, content_type, width, height, bytes, etag), never {take_id} alone. Lora values (a rows item's Lora field, the lora-stack node) are resolved too (defs lora: source, name, sha256, bytes, and for an own LoRA its key), never {lora_id} alone

output_prefix.description: u/<owner_id>/runs/<run_id>/<attempt>/ (a retried attempt never writes over the keys of the one before); output n is written to <output_prefix><n>.<ext> (the echo node: 0.png)
